name: Ghillope
look: a tall goat-rabbit hunter in a ghillie cloak of leaves bound with crossing vines, with long upright ears, horns, narrow yellow eyes and huge grey hands
entry: It wraps itself in a cloak of leaves bound with vines and waits, perfectly still, in the deepest part of the woods. Poachers who enter its forest find their traps sprung and their packs empty.
how: Evolve Shadelope at level 36. It learns Bramble Ambush when it evolves.
